hooks.command: jq -e '.tool_input.command | test("^\\s*git\\s+(commit|push|stash|tag|rebase|reset|checkout|cherry-pick|am|revert|restore|merge|rm|mv|clean|gc|notes|worktree|filter-branch|bisect)(\\s|$)")' >/dev/null && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CLAUDE.md forbids state-mutating git commands from the agent. The human operator handles all git operations manually. Read-only git commands (status, log, diff, show, blame) are allowed."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE '(^|/)Cargo\.lock$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Cargo.lock is generated by cargo. Hand-edits cause drift that CI rejects. Update Cargo.toml and run `cargo +1.92 build --workspace` (or `cargo update -p <crate>`) to regenerate."}}' || true

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.rs && "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *crates/* ]]; then crate=$(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | sed -n 's|.*crates/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p'); if [[ -n "$crate" && -f "crates/$crate/Cargo.toml" ]]; then pkg=$(awk -F'"' '/^name =/ {print $2; exit}' "crates/$crate/Cargo.toml"); if [[ -n "$pkg" ]]; then out=$(timeout 20 cargo +1.92 check -p "$pkg" --lib --tests --message-format=short --quiet 2>&1); if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then echo "[cargo check -p $pkg] errors:"; echo "$out" | grep -E '^(error)' | head -15; fi; fi; fi; fi

f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; [[ -z "$f" || ! -f "$f" ]] && exit 0; if [[ "$f" == *.rs || "$f" == *.md ]]; then grep -qE '^[[:space:]/]*```ignore\b' "$f" && echo "[writing-check] fenced 'ignore' blocks are banned. Use 'no_run' for Rust examples (validated by cargo doc) or 'text' for non-Rust content."; fi; if [[ "$f" == *.md ]]; then bad=$(awk 'BEGIN{i=0;b=0} /^[[:space:]]*```/{if(i){i=0}else{if($0~/^[[:space:]]*```[[:space:]]*$/)b++;i=1}next} END{print b+0}' "$f"); [[ "$bad" -gt 0 ]] && echo "[writing-check] $bad untagged code-fence opener(s) — language-tag every opener (e.g. rust, bash, text)."; base=$(basename "$f" .md); case "$base" in CLAUDE|AGENTS|README|MEMORY|LICENSE*|CONTRIBUTING|CHANGELOG|SECURITY|CODEOWNERS|CODE_OF_CONDUCT|SPEC|DESIGN|WHITEPAPER|PRD|NOTICE|TODO|SKILL) ;; *) [[ "$base" =~ ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ ]] || echo "[writing-check] '$base.md' is not kebab-case (lowercase letters/digits separated by hyphens).";; esac; fi; exit 0

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.md ]]; then if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(npx --yes prettier@3 --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" --log-level=warn 2>&1); [[ -n "$out" ]] && echo "$out" | head -20; fi; fi

jq -nc --arg dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Reminder: this is the InferaDB KMS workspace. Read CLAUDE.md before any non-trivial code action. Two harness-enforced rules to internalize: (1) no state-mutating git commands from the agent — `git commit/push/stash/etc` are blocked at PreToolUse; (2) Cargo.lock is generated, never hand-edited. Configuration minimalism is a golden rule — adding a knob requires a documented operator-facing reason.")}}'
